notes: Recovery access: no-desktop re-pairing. While paired, Settings -> Security generates a single-use 256-bit recovery link/code (host stores only a SHA-256 hash). Save it in a password manager. After clearing app data or reinstalling, choose 'Restore with recovery code' on the welcome screen (or open the saved dshmobile://recover link), paste the code/link, and the app pairs again without any desktop 6-digit code; the code rotates and the new link is shown once. Also adds role/date filters to host-wide search and fixes a role-echo bug. Fake-host recovery/search tests (8/13; full fake suite 162) in CI.
